title: WHO List Title
body:
Syntax: title <words> | title set <words> | title color <name|0-255> | title clear

Adds a colored cosmetic title after your character name ONLY on the WHO list. Example: Sasuke [The Last Uchiha]. This is not displayed in OOC, CHATLOG, WHOIS, SCORE, LOOK, emotes, combat, or other character displays. Your character name, account name, and command targeting are unchanged.

Titles allow 1-40 plain characters. TITLE COLOR accepts red, green, yellow, blue, cyan, magenta, purple, white, gray, orange, pink, gold, or a 0-255 palette value. TITLE previews the WHO name; TITLE CLEAR removes your title. Changes save immediately and persist across relogs/reboots.
